tweets.text:
After “dropping everything” to work on “critical” thing:

“Goodness! Why can’t we work like this ALL the time?”

“Um. We could if you didn’t have like 12 priorities, and we weren’t wading through debt...”

Crickets. Cognitive dissonance.

#focus #prodmgmt

When you have no choice but to put a roadmap on a calendar...

Stick to outcomes. Not features. Not output. #prodmgmt #ux

Invest in #ux. Seriously.

Not like one person for six teams. Not a department to feed the dev machine.

But one #ux per team. Available. “On” the team.
